title: Rav Acha son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.19), saying: “Thus said Rabbi Chiyya.” But Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads: “R’ Abba son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said: Thus said Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Berakhot names Rav Acha son of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, who reports Rabbi Chiyya quoting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman gives the shorter quotation and reports the Abba reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
